notablePrerequisites: Case of the Pilfered Proof has been solved.
description:
Cause a noncreature Clue to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Armed with Proof if it isn't an Equipment already, causing Sokka and Suki to trigger.
Resolve Sokka and Suki's second ability, creating a 1/1 white Ally creature token that triggers its first ability plus creating an additional Clue token through Case of the Pilfered Proof (which will be an Equipment due to Armed with Proof), causing Sokka and Suki to trigger.
Resolve Sokka and Suki's first ability, attaching up to one Equipment to the Ally that triggered it.
Repeat from step 2.
